change: Map non-UUID metadata from anonymous preview sessions to deterministic, scope-separated UUIDs only when requesting an SFU recording. Production identifiers and already valid preview UUIDs pass through unchanged.

notes: Consent-gated microphone recording finalized a playable WebM with RTP packets and matching source selection.
Microphone/camera capture, permission denial, device switching, room-boundary revocation, and 12-participant audio/video/screen fan-out passed.

limitations: The recording E2E uses anonymous preview identities and a local SFU; production SSO identifiers were preserved by code path but not tested against the live IdP.
Physical phone media and public TURN routing remain unverified.
